scale.N/A: Evidence is objectively insufficient and the system correctly abstains.

typicalTrace.diagnosis: Desktop 6.5.0 发布中的 chunked_upload_v2/UploadScheduler 变更是上传成功率下降的根因。

actions.rationale: 初始化调查：围绕曝光相关模式提出竞争假设，区分发布变更、后端共因与细分群体三个方向。

Segment upload success rate by app_version during the breach window to check whether the drop is isolated to 6.5.0 Desktop (supports release root cause) or appears across versions (supports independent backend incident). This first step directly discriminates the top competing hypotheses before spending budget on other dimensions.
评估 segment_metric 按 app_version 维度的结果：仅 6.5.0 成功率 0.72 且曝光 0.5，6.4.3 保持 0.97，说明异常与 6.5.0 发布版本强相关，支持发布变更假设，反证后端故障假设，但未涉及用户细分维度。

Leading hypothesis (release root cause) is SUPPORTED/MEDIUM but lacks mechanism evidence. User feedback in the incident window can confirm whether failures align with chunked_upload_v2/UploadScheduler and help discriminate the user-segment hypothesis. This will fill the feedback/mechanism gap and is not redundant with existing app_version segmentation.
处理待评估的用户反馈证据，并关联所有未拒绝的假设。
现有证据已支持发布根因：异常仅影响 6.5.0 Desktop，同窗口 6.4.3 无异常；替代的服务端故障假设已被反证，细分假设无当前事件支持且无可用工具进一步判别。按收敛规则不再低价值调用工具，FINALIZE 并建议回滚。

limitations: Small governed Dev set; no holdout split and Wilson intervals remain wide.
Six cases are repository-native and sixteen are synthetic; results cannot be generalized to enterprise production incidents.
Root-cause semantic scores use the same model family as a blind judge and are not independent or human-reviewed.
The deterministic scorer and LLM judge measure different properties; both raw outputs are retained.
Costs are estimates using published token rates and assume input cache misses; they are not invoices.
Harness v2 is a Dev experiment on the same governed cases, not a Holdout or production accuracy claim.
The v2 blind judge uses the same model family and is not independent human review.
Failed trials can have incomplete duration and token telemetry; cost and latency denominators are disclosed.
Harness v3 is a Dev experiment on the same governed cases, not a Holdout or production accuracy claim.
The v3 blind judge uses the same model family and is not independent human review.
